next.reason: Form YYYYMMDD, the calculation and the MM/DD limits are identical, but 1989 bounds the year only below ('an integer greater than 1600') while §2023:15.46.3 AR1 says 'greater than 1600 and less than 10000'. The 1989 value is defined by the calculation (YYYY * 10,000) + ..., which is valid for YYYY >= 10000, and no 1989 rule caps it; such an argument is now out of range (EC-ARGUMENT-FUNCTION per §2023:15.3 AR14).
